runs.name: ONE Gas, Inc.; NYSE and NYSE Texas OGS, SEC CIK 0001587732; Tulsa, a 100-percent regulated natural gas distribution utility, about 2.3 million customers through Oklahoma Natural Gas, Kansas Gas Service and Texas Gas Service, one reportable segment; separated from ONEOK, Inc. 2014-01-31; an equity distribution agreement with forward purchasers 2026-02-23, $375M of 5.45% notes due 2036 sold 2026-08-11; the 10-K names no rival, Atmos, Spire and NW Natural chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order key OGS-U (a re-run under Q7, The regulated utility, 2026-10-18), unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch; the earlier v5 run binds as written and was not opened. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and the competitors derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$78.36** (close 2026-10-26, aggregator, flagged) x **62,856,270 shares** (10-Q cover for the period ended 2026-06-30, accession 0001587732-26-000035; forward sales for 506,607 shares unsettled beside) = cap **$4,925M**; sovereign **5.31%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-26). **Q1 IN** (one regulated segment in three states; allowed ROE Oklahoma 9.40%, Kansas 9.60%, Texas 9.80%). **Q2 IN** (the whole the deciding part; a licensed local monopoly on buried networks, the regulator-set return carried to Q3; slow threats from electrification and a hostile regulator). The 10-K names no rival, Atmos, Spire and NW Natural chosen as a CONVENTION of the run (all three in the proxy's own peer group): all four earn about 6% to 10% on book equity 2016 to 2025, OGS mid-pack at 7.6% to 8.1% lately, below its allowed returns. **Q3 weighs against** (spending about 2.8 times depreciation net of the Kansas securitized amortization; equity added since 2020 earned about 5.6%). **Q4 IN, weighs against** (annual guidance; an adjusted net income featured from February 2026, $6.7M of $264.2M in 2025). **Q5 integrity IN** (the bonus pays on GAAP EPS; results inside guided ranges). **Q6 weighs against** (retention test unmet: $434.2M kept and about $710M of stock issued 2021 to 2025, TSR $119.72 per $100 against $158.65 for the proxy peer group; no buybacks, the test against the Q7 bottom does not arise). **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top of the range**: owner cash equity-only 2021 to 2025 **$229.3M a year** after maintenance (depreciation less the Kansas securitized amortization as the guess, a reading the analyst flags), growing 6.36%; growth spending $473.0M in year one to $823.9M in year ten; negative after all spending every year (-$130.6M to -$270.2M); utility debt credit $160.1M a year (long-term debt 2020 to 2025, KGSS-I bonds left out), cap 40.57% (Oklahoma and Texas allowed debt shares weighted by rate base, Kansas unstated and dropped), not binding; working capital at zero centrally under (d), the Uri residual -$50.5M a year beside; no acquisition. Value range **$66.59 (growth) to $68.70 (no growth) a share equity-only (central)**, the growth case below the no-growth case at the sovereign; 4.66% to 4.81% at the price, below the 5.31% sovereign; **fair price $27.59 equity-only, central**, all-equity -$7.94, not positive; beside: cash tax no-growth $80.82 (5.5% at the price), working capital charged $53.56, credit without the 13-month term loan $58.18; literal window -$252.0M a year. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed: pre-tax interest coverage 3.25x in 2025; debt to capital 47.6% against a 70% covenant; Winter Storm Uri about $2B of gas costs in February 2021 met with $2,498.9M of new notes, recovered by securitization 2022 and 2023; commercial paper $145M (2016) to $771M (2026-06-30). Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: about 5.6% on equity added since 2020, the retention test failed, stock issued every year, one weather event demanding a sudden large sum. Framework gaps for the operator: (1) whether replacement of old pipe is maintenance or growth spending for a utility under original-cost rate-making, the two readings differing by the whole value; (2) the securitized intangible's amortization inside D&A; (3) a storm deferral spanning three window years under (d); (4) the cap's weighting when an allowed share is unstated for a minority of rate base; (5) a 13-month term loan in current maturities of long-term debt; (6) book or cash tax for a utility under Whose tax. Could not get: the storm residual split from ordinary working capital; the 2022 securitization amortization exactly; rivals' figures checked against their filed statements (XBRL net income and equity only). tools/run.py's owner-earnings lines rejected by the analyst (wrong depreciation element, window ending 2023, securitization proceeds in operating cash); every figure from the filed statements. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths, last `2492fad6`. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; 90 id citations resolve, no E-ids, no citation slip, 33 adjacent fragment pairs checked, five checker mispairings resolved by hand (quotes of L2023-005, M2000-037, L2009-012, M1994-018 read beside the neighbouring id; the "little or no debt" phrase cited to no id); no tracked research file over 200 KB (the filings in the ignored cache/). Contamination declared: a Test Runs listing filtered by the company's name, which printed the 2026-10-18 OGS run file name and folder (a breach of the blind rule, declared; neither opened), and XEL commit subjects; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor (re-run under Q7, The regulated utility): a three-state gas distribution utility with a licensed local monopoly, but owner cash is negative after all spending every year, equity added since 2020 earned about 5.6%, and the central cases return 4.66% to 4.81% at the price, below the bond; value range $66.59 to $68.70 equity-only against $78.36. Fair $27.59 equity-only, central; all-equity -$7.94, not positive; armed.
